maddeler.e:
أضطرع (form VIII)
# أَضْطَرِعُ (ʔaḍṭariʕu) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.ri.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
# أَضْطَرِعَ (ʔaḍṭariʕa) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.ri.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
# أَضْطَرِعْ (ʔaḍṭariʕ) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.riʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
